prompt: Iris and Max spent twenty minutes ___ about whether to name their tiny white rabbit Professor Snowball or plain Biscuit, while the rabbit happily chewed a cardboard tag.
explanation_ru: Глагол «talk» с предлогом «about» используется для обозначения разговора или обсуждения на какую-либо тему. В данном контексте лучше всего подходит «talking», так как «speaking» звучит слишком официально для домашней беседы.

prompt: The shopkeepers ___ briskly to the local council about the bright green bicycle racks placed beside the flower buckets, until everyone agreed they kept bikes away from the doorway.
explanation_ru: В более официальном контексте обращения к представителям власти используется конструкция «speak to somebody about something».

prompt: Marco kept ___ Lucas that the garlic had to go into the pot after the onions, completely missing the pasta water boiling over behind them.
explanation_ru: После глагола «tell» сразу указывается адресат («telling Lucas that...»), тогда как «say» требует предлога «to».

prompt: While the two neighbours argued over the parked blue van, the calm traffic warden pulled out a measuring tape and ___ that the vehicle was ten centimetres clear of the driveway.
explanation_ru: Глагол «say» вводит придаточное предложение с союзом «that» («said that...»), когда не указан прямой адресат речи.

prompt: Paul and Grace had a long ___ over whether the tall sunflowers shaded the neighbouring strawberries too much, before finally sharing a basket of ripe berries.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение «have a talk» означает «поговорить, обсудить» (в отличие от «speech», обозначающего публичное выступление).

prompt: Max and Hugo were ___ loudly at each other over whose turn it was to take out the recycling bags until their cat knocked over the cardboard stack.
explanation_ru: В значении оживлённого разговора или спора (в том числе с предлогом «at» или «to») используется глагол «talk» («were talking loudly»).

prompt: Diego and Paul spent forty minutes ___ about whether to watch a slow mystery series or a bright baking show, and ended up watching neither.
explanation_ru: Глагол «talk» с предлогом «about» используется для неформального обсуждения какой-либо темы («talking about whether...»).

prompt: When the waiter brought the giant plate of chips, Victor jokingly ___ Diego that he had ordered it, even though neither of them admitted it.
explanation_ru: После глагола «tell» сразу указывается адресат речи без предлога «to» («told Diego that...»).

prompt: While Farah quietly packed two decks of cards, Iris and Lucas were ___ about whether board games belonged at a park picnic.
explanation_ru: Для описания разговора или обсуждения на конкретную тему в неформальной обстановке используется «talk about».

prompt: Rita ___ the younger visitor to turn down his loud phone game, and they argued briefly until a nurse pointed at the quiet-zone poster.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «tell someone to do something» используется для передачи просьбы или требования («told the visitor to turn down»).

prompt: Marco said Piotr that the worn copper coin was just a modern souvenir, not a seventeenth-century artifact.
answer: Marco told Piotr that the worn copper coin was just a modern souvenir, not a seventeenth-century artifact.
accepted_answers: Marco told Piotr that the worn copper coin was just a modern souvenir, not a seventeenth-century artifact.
Marco said to Piotr that the worn copper coin was just a modern souvenir, not a seventeenth-century artifact.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не используется напрямую с адресатом без предлога to; правильно: told Piotr или said to Piotr.

prompt: The other guest told that five empty chairs belonged to his family because he had put green towels on them at six in the morning.
answer: The other guest said that five empty chairs belonged to his family because he had put green towels on them at six in the morning.
accepted_answers: The other guest said that five empty chairs belonged to his family because he had put green towels on them at six in the morning.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell обязательно должно следовать прямое дополнение (кому сказали). Без указания адресата используется say (said that...).

prompt: Chloe and David spoke quietly about which mechanic to hire after one candidate fixed their squeaky door on arrival.
answer: Chloe and David spoke quietly about which mechanic to hire after one candidate fixed their squeaky door on arrival.
accepted_answers: Chloe and David spoke quietly about which mechanic to hire after one candidate fixed their squeaky door on arrival.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: speak quietly about используется корректно для описания спокойного, сдержанного обсуждения делового вопроса.

prompt: Max and Marta were saying about whether a painting with one thin red line counted as real art while a guard hid a smile.
answer: Max and Marta were talking about whether a painting with one thin red line counted as real art while a guard hid a smile.
accepted_answers: Max and Marta were talking about whether a painting with one thin red line counted as real art while a guard hid a smile.
Max and Marta were speaking about whether a painting with one thin red line counted as real art while a guard hid a smile.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не сочетается с предлогом about для обозначения темы беседы; нужно использовать talking about или speaking about.

prompt: Rita said the man in front of her to lower his bright phone screen during the quiet piano solo.
answer: Rita told the man in front of her to lower his bright phone screen during the quiet piano solo.
accepted_answers: Rita told the man in front of her to lower his bright phone screen during the quiet piano solo.
explanation_ru: Для передачи требования с инфинитивом (someone to do something) используется глагол tell (told the man to lower), а не say.

prompt: Owen told to Iris that he had not touched the blue paint, right before she spotted a blue thumbprint on his sleeve.
answer: Owen told Iris that he had not touched the blue paint, right before she spotted a blue thumbprint on his sleeve.
accepted_answers: Owen told Iris that he had not touched the blue paint, right before she spotted a blue thumbprint on his sleeve.
Owen said to Iris that he had not touched the blue paint, right before she spotted a blue thumbprint on his sleeve.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу ставится прямое дополнение (кого/кому) без предлога to: tell Iris, а не tell to Iris.

prompt: Victor and Tessa are politely debating whether to wash the glass flasks after each test or soak them all at five o'clock.
options: Victor and Tessa are speaking to when to wash the glass flasks.
Victor and Tessa are saying about when to wash the glass flasks.
Victor and Tessa are telling about when to wash the glass flasks.
Victor and Tessa are talking about when to wash the glass flasks.
explanation_ru: Для обсуждения темы используется глагол talk с предлогом about (talk about something).

prompt: Luis insists that the wool jumper shrank in cold water, so the shop supervisor calmly shows him the red dry-clean-only tag inside the collar.
options: The supervisor tells Luis that the jumper is dry-clean only.
The supervisor says Luis that the jumper is dry-clean only.
The supervisor tells to Luis that the jumper is dry-clean only.
The supervisor speaks Luis that the jumper is dry-clean only.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует указания адресата напрямую без предлога to (tell Luis that...).

prompt: Marco and David are arguing about whether the last ball touched the white line, until a passing dog runs off with the yellow ball.
options: Marco tells the ball was inside the white line.
Marco says that the ball was inside the white line.
Marco speaks that the ball was inside the white line.
Marco talks that the ball was inside the white line.
explanation_ru: Когда не указан адресат, для передачи слов или мнения используется say (that).

prompt: Carlos and Iris are joking about putting their phones in a basket during dinner, right before Carlos's watch buzzes loudly with a football alert.
options: Carlos says Iris to leave her phone in the basket.
Carlos tells Iris to leave her phone in the basket.
Carlos tells to Iris to leave her phone in the basket.
Carlos speaks Iris to leave her phone in the basket.
explanation_ru: Для передачи просьбы или совета используется конструкция tell + объект + to + инфинитив (tells Iris to leave).

prompt: Two drivers refuse to reverse thirty metres up a narrow hill, while a local farmer on a bicycle calmly rides past both of them shaking his head.
options: The two drivers refuse to tell to each other about moving back.
The two drivers refuse to say each other about moving back.
The two drivers refuse to talk to each other about moving back.
The two drivers refuse to speak each other about moving back.
explanation_ru: После глаголов talk и speak перед указанием собеседника ставится предлог to или with (talk to each other).

prompt: Tariq (say / tell) that his full bag easily fits inside the metal airport box, right before three pairs of socks pop out of the side pocket.
explanation_ru: В конструкции без указания собеседника перед придаточным с that используется глагол say.

prompt: With only four minutes left before midnight, Henrik and Samir are (speaking / talking) loudly about who forgot to upload the final lab file.
explanation_ru: Для описания оживлённого разговора или спора на определённую тему (about) естественнее всего использовать talking (также допустимо speaking).

prompt: Petra (say / tell) David that the dark grey clouds mean an all-day storm, and three seconds later rain soaks both of their shoes.
explanation_ru: Поскольку сразу после глагола указан адресат (David) без предлога to, выбираем tell (tells/told).

prompt: While Owen and Rita argue over the room heat and the missing milk, nobody in the office kitchen wants to (say / tell) a word.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение «не проронить ни слова» переводится с глаголом say: say a word.
